question_patterns: 這是什麼，裡面涼涼的大箱子
first_sentence: 這是冰箱！因為熱氣被搬到外面，裡面就冷。
facts: 冰箱裡有一種很容易變成氣的液體
液體變成氣的時候，會吸走周圍的熱
熱氣會從冰箱後面或下面排出去
ask_back: 冰箱的後面摸起來，是熱的還是冷的？

bridges.has_cat: 你家的貓咪喜歡躲在冰箱旁邊嗎？

author: claude-haiku

question_patterns: how does a fridge make things cold
en.first_sentence: This is a fridge! Heat goes outside, so the inside gets cold.
facts: Inside, a special liquid turns into gas very easily.
When liquid turns into gas, it pulls heat from nearby.
The heat leaves through the back or bottom of the fridge.
en.ask_back: Do you think the back of a fridge gets warm, or cold?

bridges.has_cat: Does your cat like to hide next to the fridge?
